$comment: The ONE config file. Anything a script needs to agree on with another script,
and anything iHiD might want to change without reading code, lives here and
nowhere else. No secret ever goes in this file: keys live in .env, which is
gitignored (see .env.example).
engine: DeepSeek translates EVERY language. There is no per-language engine
record and no second adapter, so there is nothing to route.
TODO(iHiD): `model` is pinned HERE and only here. It was copied from what
Jiki's DeepSeek languages ran on when this repo was forked. Confirm it, and
confirm the prices in scripts/lib/deepseek.mjs, before the Hungarian pass.
`concurrency` is how many calls are in flight at once within one
(locale, type) group, after the first call of the group has gone out ALONE
to warm the provider's prefix cache.
`attempts` is calls per item: a failed call or a rejected answer is retried,
then the item is left absent and reported.
`catalog_batch_units` is how many catalog units go into one JSON batch.
i18n_repo: where translated output is written and whose checker is run.
EXERCISM_I18N_REPO overrides it.
github: the issue queue. `issue_author` is the owner of the PAT the source
repos' workflows open issues with, so it is the ONLY author a queue issue may
have. `singletons` plus every repo in `org` carrying `track_topic` is the
allowlist of repos an issue may name.
issue_word_cap: an issue whose untranslated English is above this many words
(per locale) waits for iHiD instead of running on its own.
